reason: The loop in packages/core/videoClient.ts:24-26 does await each `appStore[...]` entry one after another, but each entry is a promise created when the module loads (packages/app-store/index.ts:3-11 calls `import("./...")` eagerly). So every module is already loading at the same time, and awaiting them in order takes about as long as Promise.all would; the loading is not serial.
